temporal_state_chain.observed: Cheryl appears stressed and overwhelmed by the paperwork and planning for the new community outreach project; when Maria offers help, Cheryl gratefully accepts and says she could definitely use it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria had not yet recognized that Cheryl was overwhelmed; she likely assumed Cheryl was handling the project responsibilities as usual.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria learns Cheryl is currently stressed and receptive to support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is overwhelmed with the project and would benefit from and welcome Maria's help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concern and compassion, with willingness and helpfulness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To assist Cheryl with the paperwork and planning for the community outreach project.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After helping Cheryl, Maria sees Cheryl handling responsibilities better and growing more confident; in the staff meeting, Maria nominates Cheryl for leadership, and Cheryl accepts, thanking Maria and saying she is ready.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria already believes Cheryl has improved in handling responsibilities and is growing more confident, but she does not yet know how Cheryl or the team will respond to a leadership nomination.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria learns that Cheryl welcomes the leadership role and that the team leader supports the suggestion.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl is ready and willing to lead the next phase and that her nomination was well received.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To support Cheryl in taking on the leadership role and help the project succeed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria privately checks in with Cheryl about the leadership suggestion; Cheryl says she was a bit surprised but appreciates Maria's support and belief in her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria believes Cheryl accepted the leadership role but worries that Cheryl might perceive Maria's public suggestion as overstepping or pressure.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria learns Cheryl was surprised but not upset; Cheryl values Maria's support and does not seem to feel pressured.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes Cheryl appreciates her support and that there are no hard feelings or misunderstandings.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Relief and reassurance after initial worry and concern.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To ensure Cheryl feels supported and not pressured, and to maintain a positive working relationship.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria proposes that she and Cheryl co-lead the project; Cheryl calls it a fantastic idea and says Maria's guidance has been invaluable and they make a great team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: After their private conversation, Maria believes Cheryl values her honesty and support and does not feel pressured; Maria is considering a more collaborative arrangement.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Maria learns Cheryl is enthusiastic about co-leading and values Maria's guidance and teamwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes she and Cheryl can co-lead the project effectively and support each other as a team.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To co-lead the project with Cheryl and continue supporting each other.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Maria sees that she and Cheryl have successfully collaborated on several projects and that their partnership has strengthened; when Maria raises future projects, Cheryl says she would love that and is excited about what they can achieve together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Maria already believes their collaboration has been fruitful and that they make a great team, and she is considering more joint work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes—Cheryl's response confirms and strengthens Maria's belief that their partnership is valuable and sustainable for future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Maria believes they have strong synergy and that Cheryl is eager to continue collaborating on future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To team up with Cheryl on more projects in the future.
